messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, creating at least a three‑day break.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Feb 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so it was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, PE) | Most provinces observe Family Day on the 3rd Monday of February. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (all provinces) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday; the following weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day (all provinces) | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25; gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so it was observed on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day (all provinces) | First Monday in September; gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Second Monday in October; gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day (all provinces) | Observed on Friday; gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun). |
| **Dec 25–27** | Christmas & Boxing Day (all provinces) | Christmas on Monday, Boxing Day on Tuesday; gives a 4‑day break (Mon–Thu). |

These are the only statutory holidays that produced “long weekends” in Canada during 2023. If you need the exact dates for each province (e.g., Family Day varies by province), let me know!
